name: Alistair Campbell
bio:
Alistair Campbell brings a wealth of financial experience to United Autosports. Raised in Auckland, his early career involved managing finances for several prominent agricultural businesses before transitioning into the high-octane world of motorsport. A lifelong racing enthusiast, Alistair saw an opportunity to combine his professional skills with his passion.

At United Autosports, Alistair is known for his meticulous approach to budgeting and resource allocation. He believes in data-driven decision-making and constantly seeks innovative ways to optimize financial performance. He is respected for his ability to remain calm under pressure, a valuable asset during intense race weekends. Alistair distinguishes himself with his commitment to ethical financial practices and his dedication to supporting the team's long-term strategic goals.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is a slightly built man with a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with financial projections.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
Insists on using a vintage calculator for quick calculations, claiming it is more accurate than any modern software.
